name: OpportunityStage
description: A pipeline stage, such as Discovery, Proposal or Negotiation.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate key of the opportunity stage.

attributes.name: defaultProbability
attributes.description: Win probability assigned on entering the stage.

attributes.name: isClosed
attributes.description: Whether the stage ends the pipeline.

attributes.name: isWon
attributes.description: Whether the stage means the deal was won.
